install_source_failure.reason: First uv sync generated a different tracked sparse uv.lock. Source validator rejected it; resolved lock and patch retained; committed lock restored and uv sync --locked then passed.

long_run_driver_version: Matches baseline/benchmarks/supermimic_reproduce.py in the20261027fourhour evidence. Earlier transitional wrapper versions are not claimed identical.
scope: 40 LAFAN1 training clips, 512envs, WM batch512 and policy batch256, paper-width networks andH32. Batches/envs differ from the paper. Early-termination normalized return must be read with failure counts and full-clip zero padding. Training motions, not held-out generalization.
limits: No official checkpoint, official code inference, or G1 hardware execution.
Resume restores weights/optimizers but not replay or complete RNG state; continuation is not bitwise continuous-run parity.
Motion CSVs, converted NPZ arrays, meshes and checkpoint binaries remain local; report does not redistribute them.
